fields.title: Search fraction range and tiny-core extrapolations
fields.finding: 224 differing paths arise in nonwinning projected 4/8/16 kg/m³ cores when the search extends below f=.00025. 220 recover within tolerance on the restricted range; four low-density handbook paths retain a precision residual. A representative wider-range core is only about 30 micrometres deep, far below its 4.8 mm cell scale. No physical validity or flotation is claimed.
fields.next_evidence: Declare the fraction/thickness domain and impose a justified sandwich/honeycomb geometry range before calling each per-core value an unrestricted optimum.
fields.check_disposition: Numerical/scope finding filed; does not block completion.
